d:
Three Chinese surveillance satellites kept a close watch on India's Gujarat coast during Operation Sindoor in May 2025, even as the main fighting between India and Pakistan was concentrated in Jammu and Kashmir and Punjab. An analysis by Bengaluru-based space surveillance company Digantara, exclusively accessed by ThePrint, reveals that three Chinese satellites--Ningxia-14, Gaofen-11 and Yaogan-30--focused on areas around Bhuj, Naliya and Jamnagar on 10 and 11 May.
